opening: The record concerns a conservation workshop tracing a damaged artifact through several rooms. By the time investigators reconstructed the treatment that stabilized the artifact, casual impressions had produced several plausible candidates. The reviewers therefore used only the local rules stated in the surviving record.

scenes.prose: Before comparing names, the panel read the governing notes aloud. For this incident, the board declared the certified restoration lead protocol active; ordinary rank and reputation did not count. The panel fixed one shared status scale for the whole inquiry: stable counted as 0; latent counted as 1; open counted as 2; dormant counted as 3; clear counted as 4; waking counted as 5. The local tally began at 9. In order it used relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses with coefficients 13, 3, 7, 5, 11, 2. At each stream, the panel squared the current tally, added that stream's coefficient times its status value, and kept the remainder modulo 97. It made three passes: first in the stated order, then in reverse order with the coefficients reversed, then once more in the stated order with the coefficient list rotated one place left. Without resetting the tally, it repeated that complete three-pass cycle 118 times.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 1

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. When the pairing sheet was recovered, Logan Meier's apprentice lineage stood at clear. Even the damaged roster still marked Morgan Brooks's apprentice lineage as stable. A clock-backed entry listed Logan Hassan's work interval as waking. The chemical response that followed Kai Patel registered as latent. Causal review marked Yael Nguyen's chemical response open. Door and route checks placed Logan Meier's workshop room at dormant. Witnesses in the corridor put Morgan Brooks's workshop room at clear. Reconstruction kept Logan Hassan's treatment order at latent. A close photograph of the token set Kai Patel's tool stamp to waking. At final count, Yael Nguyen's tool stamp remained latent.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 2

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. A witness who checked the roster left Kai Patel with a open apprentice lineage. On the sealed worksheet, clerks wrote dormant beside Yael Nguyen's apprentice lineage. Clocked entries put Logan Meier's work interval at clear. The sequence sheet showed Morgan Brooks's work interval as open. Downstream checks tied Logan Hassan to a stable chemical response. A movement sketch marked Kai Patel's workshop room as stable. The route ledger tied Yael Nguyen's workshop room to open. In the ordered log, Logan Meier's treatment order appeared as stable. The ordered sheet showed Morgan Brooks's treatment order as waking. Inventory counted Logan Hassan's tool stamp as open.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 3

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. In the earlier pairing note, Logan Hassan carried a waking apprentice lineage. After the timesheet review, Kai Patel's work interval stayed dormant. Reconciled timing notes kept Yael Nguyen's work interval at stable. Instruments tracing Logan Meier's action left the chemical response waking. When Morgan Brooks acted, the chemical response came back dormant. Location review left Logan Hassan's workshop room latent. Sequence notes placed Kai Patel's treatment order at clear. At sequence review, Yael Nguyen's treatment order stayed dormant. Token and seal checks left Logan Meier's tool stamp at stable. The sealed check showed Morgan Brooks's tool stamp as dormant.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 4

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. For this incident, the accepted tally was 2. The final definition was strict: the certified restoration lead was the one person whose six-stream tally equaled the accepted tally.
